about_the_game:
The Gnome Queen sets off on an incredible journey to the Cheese Moon to save the Troll Queen, who has been turned into a titan.

Join the gnomes, explore mysterious lands, help encountered creatures, battle the Order of the Red Rose, and find the mighty Rat King!

The future of an entire planet depends only on you! Fight, build, explore, and uncover all the secrets of the Cheese Moon! Are you ready to save the world?

Gnomes Garden is a classic time-management game with worker assignment: on each level you quickly gather resources (food/wood/stone/crystals), build and upgrade structures (farm, sawmill, quarry, mine, workers’ house), clear obstacles, and manage to complete the objectives for ‘3 stars’ before the timer runs out, using temporary boosts (speed-up, time stop, construction speed-up).

Game Features:

1. Mighty Rat King and the mysterious Silver Rat!

2. Grand gnome adventure across the magical Cheese Moon!

3. Incredible secrets and a new story in the Gnome Queen's world!

4. Explosions of vivid colors and living comics about great adventures!

5. Fantastically updated art style: magic in every frame!

6. New production chains to create the rarest wonderful resources!

7. Unique fantasy locations: cheese castles, mystical forests, shining plains!
